citation: Michael A. Greshko (2025), The Naibbe cipher, Cryptologia, doi:10.1080/01611194.2025.2566408.
statement: A position-known, explicit marker extension exceeds the numerical F-003, F-008 and F-019 ratio thresholds in six synthetic runs while recovering the normalized plaintext, but raises the observed token vocabulary and entropy; the constructed positional effect is not independent evidence for this mechanism in the manuscript.
methods: Use naibbe_v2.py at the linked revision, 78-card deck, RESPACING=17, UNAMBIGUOUS=True, before optional space deletion. Independent pinned texts are la_erasmus and it_dante; apply clean_line to joined vs.refcorpus.blocks_of, taking up to 32,000 letters. Seeds 0, 1, 2 seed Python random. Retain the respaced plaintext tokens. Pack output into 8 tokens per line and 4 lines per paragraph, including final partial paragraph.

Freeze the following extension independent of plaintext and ciphertext: prefix EVA p to the first and third token of every paragraph; leave all other tokens unchanged. Decode by stripping exactly that marker at those known positions, then apply Naibbe decoding. This is an explicit positional null, not a claim that these marks have been identified in the manuscript. It depends on preserved word and paragraph boundaries and does not restore original spaces, punctuation, capitalization or diacritics.

Construct the reverse map from all unigram spellings and only those bigram spellings that are not unigram spellings and have exactly one prefix/suffix code pair, as the unambiguous generator requires. Count any output whose reverse map is not a single plaintext token, and concatenate decoded tokens to verify exact normalized input recovery.

For each output measure p/f-initial fraction at paragraph openings divided by line interiors (excluding first and last words), on first lines divided by other lines, and first-line noninitial words divided by other-line noninitial words; compare to F-003 >=10, F-008 >=3 and F-019 >=3 numeric thresholds only. No page-shuffle significance or manuscript held-out test was run. Also count token types, average raw EVA character length and first-order character conditional entropy with ^ and $ token-edge symbols; these raw character metrics are not EVA-basic glyph counts.
limitations: The p insertion is deterministic and intentionally builds the tested positional signal into the text. It is not the original cipher, and observed threshold crossings alone do not establish a historical cipher or a match on other manuscript statistics. Fixed layout is artificial; type counts are uncorrected for corpus size.
